description: This file defines the CognitoIdentityProviderClient class, a PHP client to interact with Amazon Cognito Identity Provider service. It includes method annotations for various operations related to user management, group management, authentication, and other Cognito features.

classes.name: CognitoIdentityProviderClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient, tailored to Amazon Cognito Identity Provider, providing methods for user and identity management operations.

methods.name: addCustomAttributes
methods.description: Adds custom attributes to a user pool.

methods.name: adminAddUserToGroup
methods.description: Adds a user to a group as an administrator.

methods.name: adminConfirmSignUp
methods.description: Confirms user registration as an administrator.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user in the user pool.
